prompt: The MS below has M⁺ = 60 and a prominent M-18 peak at m/z 42, plus m/z 31 (small). Identify.

options.label: 1-propanol (M⁺ 60, loses H₂O → 42; α-cleavage gives m/z 31 CH₂=OH⁺)
Acetic acid (M⁺ 60; loses OH → 43 and COOH → 15; no M-18)

explanation: M⁺ 60 fits 1-propanol or acetic acid (both C₃H₈O-ish). The M-18 (loss of H₂O) is a hallmark of alcohols; acetic acid loses OH (17) or COOH (45), NOT H₂O. The m/z 31 (CH₂=OH⁺, hydroxymethyl cation) comes from α-cleavage next to OH — another alcohol diagnostic. Propanal has M⁺ 58, not 60.
